Growth curve (McFarland vs Days) reports mean ± SEM from three independent biological replicates at each time point, but only the mean symbol and error bar are plotted; the individual replicate values are not shown.
As in panel B, this growth curve shows only mean ± SEM per time point for three biological replicates without displaying the individual replicate measurements.
